name: No
overview: The biblical references to No highlight it as a significant city on the Nile River, known for its strategic and populous location surrounded by water. Scripture portrays No as a center of strength and nourishment within Egypt, yet it is also depicted as subject to God's judgment and destruction, alongside other Egyptian cities such as Zoan and Sin. These passages emphasize God's sovereign authority over nations and His power to execute justice even on mighty and fortified places like No.
